metadata.text:
Week 1  
 Project Setup & Dataset Preparation 
 
 
 Finalize system architecture 
 Set up project structure 
 Configure GitHub repository 
 Create Python virtual environment 
 Set up FastAPI and frontend (Streamlit/React) 
 Download legal datasets (Acts, judgments, contracts) 
 Organize raw and processed data folders 
 
Week 2  
Document Ingestion & Parsing Pipeline 
Goal 
 Extract clean text from multiple legal document formats. 
Tasks 
 Build PDF parser using PyMuPDF 
 Build HTML parser 
 Add OCR support for scanned PDFs 
 Extract metadata (court, date, judge, section) 
 Detect document type 
 Remove duplicate documents 
 Store cleaned documents 
 
Week 3  
 Legal Text Cleaning & Hierarchy-Aware Chunking 
Goal 
 Convert raw legal text into intelligent chunks. 
Tasks 
 Remove headers, footers, and page numbers 
 Normalize text 
 Preserve legal formatting 
 Build hierarchy-aware chunker 
 Preserve chapters, sections, subsections 
 Attach metadata to every chunk 
 Store processed chunks 
 

Week 4  
 Embedding Pipeline & Vector Database 
Goal 
 Create searchable semantic representations. 
Tasks 
 Generate embeddings 
 Implement embedding cache 
 Batch embedding pipeline 
 Set up Qdrant/PGVector 
 Store vectors with metadata 
 Create indexing pipeline 
 
Week 5  
Retrieval Pipeline & LLM Integration 
 
This is where the complete RAG pipeline is built: 
 User enters a legal query. 
 Convert the query into an embedding. 
 Retrieve relevant chunks from the vector database. 
 Perform BM25 retrieval. 
 Merge dense and sparse results. 
 Send the top results to the reranker. 
Build the final prompt with: 
 Retrieved legal context 
 User question 
 IRAC instructions 
 Send the prompt to the LLM (Claude/GPT/Gemini). 
 Receive the generated answer. 
 Display the answer. 
 
Week 6  
Cross-Encoder Reranking & Query Routing 
Goal 
 Retrieve the most relevant legal context. 
Tasks 
 Implement reranking model 
 Rank retrieved documents 
 Build query classifier 
 Route queries to different workflows 

 Create task-specific prompts 
Week 7  
Agentic RAG Workflow 
Goal 
 Transform the system into an Agentic AI application. 
Tasks 
 Build Router Agent 
 Build Retrieval Agent 
 Build Verification Agent 
 Build Legal Reasoning Agent 
 Build Formatting Agent 
 Connect agents into one workflow 
Week 8  
Citation Verification & Hallucination Prevention 
Goal 
 Increase reliability and trustworthiness. 
Tasks 
 Build citation verifier 
 Verify statutes and case citations 
 Detect hallucinated citations 
 Add confidence scoring 
 Implement abstention mechanism 
 
Week 9  
Multi-Document Reasoning & Citation Graph 
Goal 
 Improve legal reasoning across multiple sources. 
Tasks 
 Build citation graph 
 Link related judgments 
 Implement precedent chaining 
 Retrieve multiple related documents 
 Build evidence aggregation module 
 

Week 10  
User Interface & Explainability 
Goal 
 Create a professional user experience. 
Tasks 
 Build chat interface 
 Implement document upload 
 Display retrieved sources 
 Add explainability panel 
 Show similarity scores 
 Enable streaming responses 
 Store chat history 
 
Week 11  
 Evaluation Framework & Feedback Loop 
Goal 
 Measure and improve system quality. 
Tasks 
 Create golden QA dataset 
 Integrate RAGAS 
 Evaluate faithfulness 
 Measure context precision and recall 
 Build hallucination benchmark 
 Add user feedback collection 
 
Week 12  
 Production Features & Deployment 
Goal 
 Prepare the system for real-world use. 
Tasks 
 Implement JWT authentication 
 Add rate limiting 
 Secure file uploads 
 Add logging and monitoring 
 Dockerize the application 
 Configure CI/CD 
 Deploy to Railway/Render/AWS 
 
 

Week 13  
Testing, Optimization & Documentation 
Goal 
 Polish the project for interviews and your portfolio. 
Tasks 
 Perform end-to-end testing 
 Optimize latency 
 Improve retrieval performance 
 Write comprehensive README 
 Prepare architecture diagrams 
 Record demo video 
 Document evaluation results 
 Prepare resume bullet points and presentation
